question: Why does the existing discrete density projection alter physically valid tangential shear? Bounded diagnosis, no replacement solver or production change.
reference: Constant rho1000; flat material slab H=.05,Lx=Lz=.2; volume-preserving map x=X+gamma*sin(kY)/k,y=Y,z=Z. u_x=U sin(kY),u_y=u_z=0. Tangential pressure gradient and pressure correction are exactly zero for hydrostatic p=rho*g*(H-y). Periodic bulk sinusoid uses k=2pi/H and constant manufactured p, so no boundary or hydrostatic load is needed. Affine bulk shear detF=1 provides independent local consistency check.

experiments.frozen_operator: Exact horizontal-symmetry reduction, all individual particle derivatives retained for native Jacobi diagonal. Save C, full reduced J, native diagonal, manufactured pressure, pressure action, exact Gram projection. Check unstrained and strained geometries; native sparse-J comparison and finite differences validate reduction.
experiments.space: Ny4,8,12,16,24,32; support/spacing2,3,4; targeted Ny64 support6,8. Keep physical geometry/mass fixed; h=q*H/Ny. Repeat fixed q refinement and q-increasing/h-decreasing sequences. No assertion that dx refinement alone is consistency.
experiments.surface_boundary: Same material sites/map; natural top with mirrored bed; mirrored top/bottom closure; fully periodic smooth shear with h<H/2; fixed bed samples versus reflected bed with horizontal phase changes. Manufactured pressure references stated per closure. Compare rows farther than2h from boundaries with boundary/surface rows.
experiments.native_pressure_only: At most20 one-step cases, nu0/contactoff. Manufactured isochoric shear with U0,g0 isolates density restoration from physics. Separately one-step replay of retained n4 state at0.2s, g9.81, no viscosity. Save every iteration p,C,lambda,pressure correction and first sparse Jacobian.
experiments.controls: Vary epsilon*h^2=0,.002,.02,.2; iterations1,24,96; dt1/480 versus1/960; refreshed versus frozen neighbour identities with current positions/ghost coordinates. One factor per paired comparison. Ny4/8/12 and q2/3/4 native spot checks only, not full coupled qualification.
experiments.exact_projection: Offline dense solve/pseudoinverse of the SAME J Gram matrix; no epsilon and no Jacobi limit. Measure whether physical tangential velocity lies in its nullspace and whether a converged existing constraint can preserve it. This is an oracle, not a replacement pressure method.

criteria.conclusion: A repeatable nonzero pressure force or alteration of admissible isochoric shear in boundary-free frozen tests establishes a discrete consistency defect. A native/independent mismatch establishes implementation error. Regularisation/neighbour controls quantify modifiers, not attribution from residual alone.

stop_rule: Stop at a demonstrated cause with controlled exclusions. Do not develop a new solver or rerun long collision campaigns. A prospective replacement needs an explicit validation strategy before implementation.
retention: Exclusive output labels; full raw numpy/native arrays and iteration traces; requests/source identities/checksums; durable workspace plus independent primary-PC home mirror; old evidence preserved.
